items.title: S1–S6 solvent-dependent aqueous reductions
items.summary: The source prepares 0.05 M Co(AOT)₂ stocks in xylene (S1), cyclohexane (S2), cumene (S3), decane (S4), octane (S5) and isooctane (S6). Water is added at w=[H₂O]/[AOT]=2, followed by 1 M aqueous NaBH₄ at R=[NaBH₄]/[Co(AOT)₂]=6. The absolute precursor, water, reductant, solvent and ligand-exchange reagent amounts are not stated. Synthesis is at room temperature in an N₂ glovebox with deoxygenated solvents; the source gives no numerical temperature, pressure, or growth time.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed 22055), §2.4, Synthesis of Metallic Cobalt NPs

items.title: Aqueous NaBH₄ addition and reverse-micelle limit
items.summary: The reported mixture changes from purple to black instantaneously after aqueous NaBH₄ addition. The authors state that the large aqueous volume destroys the reverse micelles; particle growth should not be represented as confined within intact reverse micelles. Instant color change is not a verified reaction-completion time.

items.title: AOT extraction, washing and first centrifugation
items.summary: After synthesis, dodecanoic acid is added to extract AOT; the article gives no dose or proof of complete exchange. The material is washed with ethanol several times, redispersed in hexane and centrifuged. The upper hexane phase is collected for S1–S6 while bulky material precipitates. Wash count, volumes and centrifugation settings are not specified.

items.title: S7 is a secondary extraction of S6 precipitate
items.summary: After removing S6's upper hexane phase, only part of the remaining precipitate is redispersed in cyclohexane to obtain S7. This is a post-growth size-selected fraction, not direct cyclohexane growth. The amount dispersed is not stated.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed 22056), §3.1, S7 second-extraction discussion and Table 2

items.title: Separate two-dimensional, thin-three-dimensional and thick-three-dimensional procedures
items.summary: For 2D assembly, one drop of 5.5×10⁻⁷ M Co-NC solution is deposited on HOPG attached to a Cu TEM grid and supported on paper. Thin 3D assembly uses a graphite support and slower evaporation; no drop volume, time or temperature is supplied. Thick 3D Raman samples use a 10×5 mm horizontal HOPG substrate immersed in 200 µL of 5.5×10⁻⁷ M solution and evaporation at 35 °C under N₂ flow. The concentration's molar basis, N₂ flow rate and evaporation time are not specified. 35 °C is an assembly condition, not growth temperature or Raman measurement temperature. Methods name S1–S4 for thick assemblies, while Figures 4–5 include S6/S7 contexts; preserve this unresolved scope.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed 22055), §2.5, Assembly Preparation; p. 6 (printed 22059), §3.4

items.title: Table 2 solvent-size outcomes and UV–vis cobalt fractions
items.summary: Table 2 reports S1–S7 mean diameters and relative standard deviations. Each histogram includes at least 500 measured diameters. The authors estimate about 11% cobalt volume fraction for S1–S6 and 4% for S7 by UV–vis; their denominator is cobalt in the colloidal solution divided by cobalt initially used, not gravimetric yield or conversion. S1 mean is 3.9 nm in Table 2 but Figure 2a labels the plotted S1 mean 3.8 nm; both values remain separate. S7 is a secondary fraction from S6 precipitate.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed 22056), Table 2 and §3.1 UV–vis volume-fraction discussion; §2.3 p. 2 (printed 22055), size histograms

items.title: Tentative electron-diffraction indexing; no definitive refined sample phase
items.summary: Diffuse rings at 0.204±0.001 and 0.120±0.001 nm are said to be potentially indexable as fcc-Co 111 and 220. The indexing is tentative and is not a sample-specific refinement or atomic-coordinate assignment. The paper distinguishes hexagonal particle superlattice order from the atomic phase; image Fourier transforms are not separate acquired diffraction patterns.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed 22056), Figure 1 and electron-diffraction discussion

items.title: Table 4 S3 label is unresolved
items.summary: Table 4 row is printed as S3 with solvent label ‘xyclohexane’ and size 4.6 nm, while Table 2 assigns S2 to cyclohexane at 4.6 nm and S3 to cumene at 4.7 nm. The Table 4 row is retained verbatim and is not reassigned to either growth route.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 5 (printed 22058), Table 4; compare p. 3 (printed 22056), Table 2

items.title: Low-wavenumber Raman findings
items.summary: The authors assign the lowest-frequency feature to an ℓ=2 quadrupolar mode and another to an ℓ=0 breathing mode; abstract endpoints are approximate and are not digitized per trace. Figure 5 labels S2 at 4.5 nm and S7 at 9.1 nm; Table 2 gives 4.6 and 9.3 nm. Raman spectra are described as averages of three experiments under the same conditions; fit error bars are distinct from unreported batch identity. The reported 100 µW at focus does not prove the sample avoided local heating.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed 22055), §2.2; p. 6 (printed 22059), §3.5, Figure 5 and abstract p. 1

items.title: Hansen-parameter calculations and size relation
items.summary: Table 1 lists solvent Hansen parameters collected from references 24–25; Table 3 reports author-calculated solvent–AOT and hexane–dodecanoic-acid interaction parameters. The source prints χ12 in J mol−1 while Eq. 2's dimensional presentation may be inconsistent. Eq. 3 prints log(d)=0.944−0.211 log(χ12), without specifying logarithm base, and claims prediction within about 1 nm. Values are transcribed but not independently recalculated or refit; T=298.15 K belongs to the model calculation only.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed 22056), Table 1; p. 4 (printed 22057), Table 3 and Eqs. 2–3

items.title: Independent CSV downloads for Tables 1–4 and Figure 2b labels
items.summary: Four tables and the four Figure 2b printed repeat annotations are supplied as separate CSV downloads. No rows are joined across tables, no histogram bins are digitized and the Figure 2b repeats are not equated to the Table 2 reference batch.

evidence.locator: Main PDF pp. 3–5 (printed 22056–22058), Tables 1–4; p. 4 (printed 22057), Figure 2b

source_gaps: Supporting information was not located or verified; no SI claims included.
Upstream Co(AOT)₂ preparation is cited to reference 19 but was not reviewed.
Absolute precursor-stock, water, NaBH₄ and growth-solvent charges are unreported; ratios and stock concentrations alone do not give absolute recipe volumes.
Reaction time, numerical room temperature, glovebox pressure, shaking rate, washing count/volumes and centrifugation settings are unreported.
Exact batch identities across TEM, diffraction, Raman and assembly contexts are not supplied.
No definitive sample-specific refined atomic phase, CIF or coordinates are reported.
Original figure rights/permission are unverified; independent figure crop and CSV audits are pending.
Source equations and the S3 Table 4 row have unresolved interpretation/label issues retained without correction.

UV–vis wavelength/calibration and numerical absorbances are not stated for cobalt volume-fraction estimates; preserve the source-defined Co-in-colloid / Co-initially-used basis rather than treating these as mass yield/conversion.
